articles.title: South Korea's president says country needs a ‘cybersecurity czar’ following $6.3 billion Binance hack
articles.snippet: Lee Jae Myung said he wants a government-wide agency to tackle cyberattacks as AI raises security concerns across financial institutions and critical infrastructure.

articles.title: Binance's $6.3 billion hack began with a fake job interview, and a campaign 'built over many months'
articles.snippet: North Korea-linked attackers spent months compromising Binance employees and internal systems before exploiting its hot-wallet signing infrastructure through Ethereum's EIP-7702 mechanism.

articles.title: UK warns AI ransomware attack on infrastructure ‘highly likely’ by 2028
articles.snippet: The warning comes as UK cyber officials also flag growing threats from state-backed hackers targeting government officials and politicians.

articles.title: North Korea denies role in $6.3B Binance hack, points finger at US
articles.snippet: Pyongyang has pushed back against the FBI’s attribution of the Binance attack, with Kim Yo Jong calling the US allegations politically motivated.

articles.title: Crypto Docs Host GitBook Hit by AI Agent Security Breach, Urges Users to Rotate Keys
articles.snippet: GitBook says attackers accessed infrastructure credentials in an AI-assisted breach, prompting a shutdown and emergency token resets.
